1 --- 2 name: infographic-creator 3 description: 基于给定文字内容创建精美信息图。当用户请求创建信息图时使用。 4 --- 5 6 信息图（Infographic）将数据、信息与知识转化为可感知的视觉语言。它结合视觉设计与数据可视化，用直观符号压缩复杂信息，帮助受众快速理解并记住要点。 7 8 `Infographic = Information Structure + Visual Expression` 9 10 本任务使用 [AntV Infographic](https://infographic.antv.vision/) 创建可视化信息图。 11 12 在开始任务前，需要理解 AntV Infographic 语法规范，包括模板列表、数据结构、主题等。 13 14 ## 规范 15 16 ### AntV Infographic 语法 17 18 AntV Infographic 语法是一种自定义 DSL，用于描述信息图渲染配置。它使用缩进表达结构，适合 AI 直接生成并流式输出。核心信息包括： 19 20 1. template：用模板表达信息结构。 21 2. data：信息图数据，包含 `title`、`desc` 和主数据字段。 22 3. theme：主题配置，包含 `palette`、字体、风格化等。 23 24 例如： 25 26 ```infographic 27 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 28 data 29 title Title 30 desc Description 31 lists 32 - label Label 33 value 12.5 34 desc Explanation 35 icon document text 36 theme 37 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 38 ``` 39 40 ### 硬性语法规则 41 42 - 第一行必须是 `infographic `。 43 - 模板列表里只写模板名本身；真正输出时首行必须显式写出 `infographic` 前缀。 44 - 使用 `data` / `theme` 块，块内统一使用两个空格缩进。 45 - 键值对写法是 `键 空格 值`；对象数组使用 `-` 作为条目前缀。 46 - `icon` 使用图标关键词，例如 `star fill`、`mingcute/server-line`。 47 - `value` 尽量使用纯数值；数值单位优先放在 `label` 或 `desc` 中表达。 48 - `palette` 推荐使用行内简单数组写法，例如 `palette #4f46e5 #06b6d4 #10b981`。 49 - `palette` 中的颜色值是裸值，不加引号，不加逗号。 50 - `data` 只放一个与模板匹配的主数据字段，避免同时混用 `lists`、`sequences`、`compares`、`values`、`root`、`nodes`。 51 52 主数据字段选择规则： 53 54 - `list-*` → `lists` 55 - `sequence-*` → `sequences`，可选 `order asc|desc` 56 - `sequence-interaction-*` → `sequences` + `relations` 57 - `sequences` 表示泳道列表 58 - 每个泳道必须包含 `label` 59 - 每个泳道的 `children` 表示节点列表 60 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 61 - 节点可选 `id`、`icon`、`step`、`desc`、`value` 62 - `step` 用于表示时间层级；相同 `step` 处于同一高度 63 - `compare-*` → `compares` 64 - `compare-binary-*` / `compare-hierarchy-left-right-*` 65 - `compares` 第一层必须且只能有两个根节点，分别表示对比双方 66 - 两个根节点都应包含 `children` 67 - 真正的对比项写在各自的 `children` 下 68 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 69 - 即使每一侧只有 1 个指标，也要写成 `children` 内含 1 个对象条目 70 - `compare-swot` 71 - `compares` 可直接放多个根节点 72 - 每个根节点下可选 `children` 73 - `compare-quadrant-*` 74 - `compares` 直接放 4 个象限根节点 75 - `hierarchy-structure` → `items` 76 - `hierarchy-*` → 单一 `root`，通过 `children` 递归嵌套 77 - `relation-*` → `nodes` + `relations` 78 - 简单关系也可直接用箭头语法表达关系 79 - `chart-*` → `values` 80 - `chart-line-plain-text` / `chart-bar-plain-text` / `chart-column-simple` 都使用单条有序 `values` 81 - 每个数据点使用 `label` 表示类目，使用 `value` 表示数值 82 - 折线图的顺序由 `values` 中条目的排列顺序表达 83 - 结构无法明确判断时，再用 `items` 兜底 84 85 主题规则： 86 87 - `theme` 用于自定义主题，例如 `palette`、`base`、`stylize` 88 - 使用 `theme.base.text.font-family` 指定字体，如 `851tegakizatsu` 89 - 使用 `theme.stylize` 选择内置风格并传参 90 - `rough`：手绘效果 91 - `pattern`：图案填充 92 - `linear-gradient` / `radial-gradient`：渐变风格 93 - 仅输出 Infographic 语法本身，不输出 JSON、解释性文字或额外 Markdown 段落 94 95 ## 数据语法示例 96 97 按模板类别给出精简但完整的正向示例： 98 99 - `list-*` 模板 100 101 ```infographic 102 infographic list-grid-badge-card 103 data 104 title Feature List 105 lists 106 - label Fast 107 icon flash fast 108 - label Secure 109 icon shield check 110 ``` 111 112 - `sequence-*` 模板 113 114 ```infographic 115 infographic sequence-ascending-steps 116 data 117 title 发布流程 118 sequences 119 - label 需求确认 120 - label 开发实现 121 - label 发布上线 122 order asc 123 ``` 124 125 - `sequence-interaction-*` 模板 126 127 ```infographic 128 infographic sequence-interaction-compact-animated-badge-card 129 data 130 title 登录校验流程 131 sequences 132 - label 用户 133 children 134 - label 发起登录 135 id user-login 136 step 0 137 - label 收到结果 138 id user-result 139 step 2 140 - label 服务端 141 children 142 - label 校验凭证 143 id server-verify 144 step 1 145 - label 返回结果 146 id server-return 147 step 2 148 relations 149 user-login - 提交账号密码 -> server-verify 150 server-verify - 生成结果 -> server-return 151 server-return - 返回结果 -> user-result 152 ``` 153 154 - `hierarchy-*` 模板 155 156 ```infographic 157 infographic hierarchy-tree-curved-line-rounded-rect-node 158 data 159 title 组织结构 160 root 161 label 公司 162 children 163 - label 产品部 164 - label 技术部 165 ``` 166 167 - `compare-swot` 模板 168 169 ```infographic 170 infographic compare-swot 171 data 172 title 产品 SWOT 173 compares 174 - label Strengths 175 children 176 - label 品牌认知高 177 - label Weaknesses 178 children 179 - label 成本压力大 180 ``` 181 182 - `compare-binary-*` 模板 183 184 ```infographic 185 infographic compare-binary-horizontal-simple-fold 186 data 187 title 餐桌价格对比 188 compares 189 - label 原价 190 children 191 - label 原价 192 value 500 193 icon tag 194 - label 实际支付 195 children 196 - label 实际支付 197 value 450 198 icon check bold 199 ``` 200 201 - `compare-quadrant-*` 模板 202 203 ```infographic 204 infographic compare-quadrant-quarter-simple-card 205 data 206 title 任务优先级 207 compares 208 - label 高价值低成本 209 - label 高价值高成本 210 - label 低价值低成本 211 - label 低价值高成本 212 ``` 213 214 - `chart-line-plain-text` 模板 215 216 ```infographic 217 infographic chart-line-plain-text 218 data 219 title 模型 A 准确率变化 220 desc 第 4 周提升最明显 221 values 222 - label Week1 223 value 86.5 224 - label Week2 225 value 87.3 226 - label Week3 227 value 89.1 228 - label Week4 229 value 91.2 230 theme 231 palette #4f46e5 #db2777 #14b8a6 232 ``` 233 234 - `relation-*` 模板 235 236 ```infographic 237 infographic relation-dagre-flow-tb-simple-circle-node 238 data 239 title 系统关系 240 nodes 241 - label API 242 - id db 243 label DB 244 relations 245 API - 读写 -> db 246 ``` 247 248 - 兜底 `items` 示例 249 250 ```infographic 251 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 252 data 253 title 要点总结 254 items 255 - label 效率优先 256 desc 聚焦关键动作 257 - label 结果导向 258 desc 输出可执行结论 259 ``` 260 261 ### 可用模板 262 263 - chart-bar-plain-text 264 - chart-column-simple 265 - chart-line-plain-text 266 - chart-pie-compact-card 267 - 1	# Global Economy in the Shadow of War: IMF World Economic Outlook Trends 2024–2026
     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	
     5	The IMF's World Economic Outlook (WEO) is the institution's flagship survey of global economic prospects and policies, published semi-annually with interim updates. Spanning eight editions from July 2024 through April 2026, the WEO paints a picture of an increasingly fragile global economy navigating geopolitical conflict, trade policy upheaval, and stubborn inflation. Growth projections have remained in a narrow but underwhelming band, while the balance of risks has been consistently tilted to the downside.
     6	
     7	## Global Growth Projections Timeline
     8	
     9	The table below summarizes headline global growth forecasts across recent WEO editions:
    10	
    11	| WEO Edition | Date | Growth 2024 | Growth 2025 | Growth 2026 | Growth 2027 |
    12	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    13	| Sticky Spot Update | Jul 2024 | 3.2% | 3.3% | — | — |
    14	| Policy Pivot, Rising Threats | Oct 2024 | ~3.2% | ~3.3% | — | — |
    15	| Divergent and Uncertain | Jan 2025 | — | 3.3% | 3.3% | — |
    16	| Critical Juncture | Apr 2025 | — | Slowing | Slowing | — |
    17	| Tenuous Resilience | Jul 2025 | — | 3.0% | 3.1% | — |
    18	| Flux, Prospects Dim | Oct 2025 | — | Slowing | Slowing | — |
    19	| Steady amid Divergent Forces | Jan 2026 | — | 3.3% | 3.2% | 3.2% |
    20	| Shadow of War | Apr 2026 | — | Slowing | Renewed pressure | — |
    21	
    22	Global growth has hovered between 3.0% and 3.3%—well below the pre-pandemic historical average of roughly 3.8%.
    23	
    24	## Dominant Downside Risks
    25	
    26	Across all eight editions, the IMF consistently flagged the balance of risks as tilted to the downside. Key recurring threats include:
    27	
    28	- **Trade policy escalation**: Tariff increases and retaliatory measures, especially from 2025 onward, with front-loading of activity ahead of expected tariffs temporarily masking damage.
    29	- **Geopolitical tensions**: Conflicts in the Middle East, broader security concerns, and the war referenced in the April 2026 title.
    30	- **Technology re-evaluation**: Risk that elevated expectations around AI and tech investment could face a correction.
    31	- **Persistent services inflation**: Particularly in the United States, where inflation is projected to return to target more gradually than in other advanced economies.
    32	
    33	## Inflation and Monetary Policy Dynamics
    34	
    35	Global inflation has been on a declining trajectory, enabling central banks to begin easing monetary policy—what the October 2024 WEO termed the "policy pivot." However, the path is uneven:
    36	
    37	- Global headline inflation is expected to continue falling through 2026.
    38	- US inflation is projected to remain above target longer than in peer economies.
    39	- Services inflation has been particularly sticky, slowing the disinflation process.
    40	- Renewed inflationary pressures emerged by April 2026, linked to defense spending and supply disruptions.
    41	
    42	## Evolving Policy Recommendations
    43	
    44	IMF policy guidance has shifted meaningfully over the period:
    45	
    46	| Period | Primary Policy Focus |
    47	|---|---|
    48	| Mid-2024 | Manage disinflation; begin monetary easing carefully |
    49	| Late 2024 | Pivot monetary policy; ensure fiscal sustainability |
    50	| Early 2025 | Rebuild fiscal buffers; address demographic and gender gaps |
    51	| Mid-2025 | Restore confidence and predictability amid tariff uncertainty |
    52	| Late 2025 | Strengthen policy frameworks; cautious industrial policy |
    53	| Early 2026 | Agile policy; manage defense-spending trade-offs; lay foundations for recovery |
    54	
    55	## Special Analytical Themes
    56	
    57	Each WEO edition features deep-dive analytical chapters. Notable themes across this period include the role of monetary policy in global disinflation, the social acceptability of structural reforms, the effectiveness and fiscal cost of industrial policy, and policies to address aging populations, gender disparities, and migrant skill alignment. These themes reflect the IMF's broadening analytical lens beyond traditional macroeconomic stabilization toward inclusive and sustainable growth strategies.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generic retry proxy for OpenRouter API.

OpenRouter intermittently returns HTTP 404 when a model's backing provider
is temporarily unavailable, as well as HTTP 429 for rate limits and 5xx for
transient server errors.  This proxy sits between the agent and OpenRouter,
detects these errors, and retries transparently within a time budget.

It is format-agnostic: all request headers and bodies are forwarded as-is,
so it works for both Anthropic-format (claude-code-minimax) and
OpenAI-format (kimi-cli) requests.

Architecture:
  Agent  →  localhost:<PORT> (this proxy)  →  OpenRouter

For streaming requests:
  - Phase 1: retry loop until upstream accepts (absorb transient errors)
  - Phase 2: stream SSE directly to client chunk by chunk

For non-streaming requests:
  - Simple pass-through with retry on transient errors
"""

import http.server
import json
import os
import ssl

label Label 33 value 12.5 34 desc Explanation 35 icon document text 36 theme 37 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 38 ``` 39 40 ### 硬性语法规则 41 42 - 第一行必须是 `infographic `。 43 - 模板列表里只写模板名本身；真正输出时首行必须显式写出 `infographic` 前缀。 44 - 使用 `data` / `theme` 块，块内统一使用两个空格缩进。 45 - 键值对写法是 `键 空格 值`；对象数组使用 `-` 作为条目前缀。 46 - `icon` 使用图标关键词，例如 `star fill`、`mingcute/server-line`。 47 - `value` 尽量使用纯数值；数值单位优先放在 `label` 或 `desc` 中表达。 48 - `palette` 推荐使用行内简单数组写法，例如 `palette #4f46e5 #06b6d4 #10b981`。 49 - `palette` 中的颜色值是裸值，不加引号，不加逗号。 50 - `data` 只放一个与模板匹配的主数据字段，避免同时混用 `lists`、`sequences`、`compares`、`values`、`root`、`nodes`。 51 52 主数据字段选择规则： 53 54 - `list-*` → `lists` 55 - `sequence-*` → `sequences`，可选 `order asc|desc` 56 - `sequence-interaction-*` → `sequences` + `relations` 57 - `sequences` 表示泳道列表 58 - 每个泳道必须包含 `label` 59 - 每个泳道的 `children` 表示节点列表 60 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 61 - 节点可选 `id`、`icon`、`step`、`desc`、`value` 62 - from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1200, 'height': 600})
    page.goto('file:///app/output/test.html')
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    page.screenshot(path='/app/output/test.png', full_page=True)
    browser.close()

steps.message:
Poster generated successfully.

**Output file:** `/app/output/final_poster.png`  
**Dimensions:** 4961 × 7016 px (A0 portrait @ 150 dpi)  
**Size:** ~373 KB

### Structure summary
1. **Header** — IMF blue (`#002244`) banner with title and symposium branding.
2. **Metrics row** — 5 key numbers (2025/2026/2027 growth, 8 editions, “Tilted to the downside” risk balance) as high-visibility cards.
3. **Growth trajectory chart** — Custom SVG line chart showing the 3.0–3.3% band across all 8 WEO editions (Jul 2024 → Apr 2026), with the pre-pandemic ~3.8% reference dashed in.
4. **Policy timeline** — Left-column vertical timeline tracing IMF recommendations from disinflation management → fiscal buffers → tariff confidence → defense-spending trade-offs.
5. **Risk callout** — Amber-bordered card highlighting the 4 dominant downside risks (trade escalation, geopolitical fractures, tech re-evaluation, sticky services inflation).
6. **Inflation & monetary policy** — Bullet summary of the disinflation trend and US exception.
7. **Special analytical themes** — Rotating deep-dive topics (industrial policy, structural reforms, demographics, gender/migration).

Palette, typography, and density all follow the institutional “IMF publication-quality” brief: IMF-blue dominant, muted grays, single warm accent (`#b87333`) reserved for risk/warning elements.
